display_long_description:
Whispers of the Wendigo is a multiplayer VR horror survival experience set deep within a cold, haunted forest. Trapped with other players, your only objective is to survive as long as possible while an unseen presence stalks you through the darkness.

Explore the forest to find safety, follow distant sounds that may guide—or mislead—you, and decide whether staying together or splitting up will increase your chances of survival. The Wendigo lurks beyond the fog, watching, listening, and striking when fear takes hold.

Built from the ground up for VR, Whispers of the Wendigo emphasizes immersion, proximity voice chat, and intense psychological horror. Every footstep, every whisper, and every scream matters—because in this forest, being heard can be a death sentence.
